observations: Two solar panels leaning against a wall.
The panels have a silver aluminum frame.
The front surface is covered with dark photovoltaic cells.
A watermark 'IZUTECH SOLAR ENERGY' is visible across the center of the image.
The background shows a concrete floor and a motorcycle in the distance.

claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment
claims.evidence: The seller's business description cannot be verified from a single photo of panels.
Only panels are shown; other equipment is not visible.

risks.risk: The panels may be used or have degraded output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc) of the panels.

risks.risk: The panels may be counterfeit or of unknown wattage.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panels.

risks.risk: The panels may have micro-cracks or surface defects not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cell surfaces and a video of the panels in direct sunlight.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of a multimeter test showing the voltage output.
Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panels.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
